d:
A mob attacked BSF personnel near the India-Bangladesh border in Tripura’s Sepahijala district. Four jawans, including an Assistant Commandant, were injured, and a BSF vehicle was vandalised. The clash reportedly began after a local man was allegedly assaulted during an anti-smuggling operation. Eight people have been arrested and 19 booked. What triggered the violence, and what does it reveal about tensions along the border?

Video Editor: Satyam
